name: Remove fuel subsidy
description: Stop paying for cheap petrol. The treasury breathes; the pump price does not.

sideEffects.note: Pump prices jump overnight and transport fares follow.
Households feel it at the pump and in the market.
The Workers' Congress issues a strike notice.

advisorTake.finance: This is the single biggest saving available. Do it before the treasury runs dry.
advisorTake.security: Fuel queues and angry crowds are a security problem. Plan for protests.
advisorTake.health: Ambulances run on fuel too. Please protect emergency services.
advisorTake.politics: Senators will want something in return, and the unions will want your head.

name: Float the naira
description: Let the market set the exchange rate. Investors like it; importers do not.

sideEffects.note: The naira drops sharply on the first day of trading.

advisorTake.finance: A realistic rate closes the gap and brings investment. The first weeks will hurt.
advisorTake.security: Black-market dealers lose out. Expect noise from them.
advisorTake.health: Imported medicines will cost more. Budget for it.
advisorTake.politics: Nobody ever won votes on a falling currency, even a correct one.

name: Raise VAT
description: Add a few points to consumption tax. Reliable money, unpopular method.

advisorTake.finance: Broad base, steady yield. Collect it properly and it works.
advisorTake.security: More revenue could fund more patrols. I am listening.
advisorTake.health: Please ring-fence some of it for hospitals.
advisorTake.politics: Everyone pays it, so everyone hates it. Time it carefully.

name: Ban selected imports
description: Close the door on some imports to give local producers room to grow.

sideEffects.note: Shelves thin out and prices rise.
Smuggling routes get busy at the borders.

advisorTake.finance: Protection helps young industries but taxes every consumer. Watch the prices.
advisorTake.security: Bans create smuggling. That means more work at the borders.
advisorTake.health: Medical supplies must be exempt. Please.
advisorTake.politics: Local manufacturers will cheer. Traders will not.

name: Recruit and equip police
description: Hire, train and kit out more officers across the country.

sideEffects.note: A bigger force means more places for money to go missing.

advisorTake.finance: A heavy recurring bill. Make sure payroll is clean.
advisorTake.security: Finally, a sensible idea. Boots on the ground win.
advisorTake.health: Fewer incidents means fewer casualties. I support it.
advisorTake.politics: Jobs for young people in every state. Very good optics.

name: Military surge in a zone
description: Send a short, heavy deployment to one zone.

sideEffects.note: Residents feel the strain of a heavy presence.

advisorTake.finance: Expensive per week. Set an end date.
advisorTake.security: Concentrated force works quickly. Short and decisive.
advisorTake.health: Displaced families need clinics. Please plan for them.
advisorTake.politics: Governors in that zone will want a say.

name: Amnesty and rehabilitation programme
description: Offer a way out and a way back to people willing to lay down arms.

sideEffects.note: Critics say it rewards the wrong people.

advisorTake.finance: Cheaper than endless operations if it works. The payoff is slow.
advisorTake.security: It can work alongside pressure, not instead of it.
advisorTake.health: Rehabilitation needs counsellors and clinics, not just paperwork.
advisorTake.politics: A hard sell. You will pay for it before you benefit.

name: Refinery refurbishment
description: Fix the national refineries so we refine more of what we produce.

advisorTake.finance: A very large bill with a long wait. Contractors love these.
advisorTake.security: Refineries need guarding. Add that to the cost.
advisorTake.health: Cleaner fuel supply helps hospital generators too.
advisorTake.politics: A ribbon-cutting, eventually. Possibly in the next term.

name: Power sector reform
description: Restructure distribution and raise tariffs so the lights stay on.

sideEffects.note: Tariff increases show up on electricity bills.

advisorTake.finance: Subsidised power drains the budget. Reform pays for itself over time.
advisorTake.security: Street lighting and working grids reduce crime.
advisorTake.health: Hospitals need steady power more than anyone.
advisorTake.politics: Higher bills, years before the benefit. Brave.

name: Social cash transfer
description: Send regular cash to the poorest households.

sideEffects.note: Some of the money does not reach the people it was meant for.

advisorTake.finance: A permanent commitment. Check the beneficiary list first.
advisorTake.security: Hungry people are easier to recruit for the wrong causes. I approve.
advisorTake.health: Better nutrition shows up in clinic numbers within a year.
advisorTake.politics: Popular, visible, and hard to cancel later.

name: Anti-corruption drive
description: Strengthen audits and prosecutions across federal and state offices.

sideEffects.note: Powerful people in the Assembly do not enjoy being audited.

advisorTake.finance: Every naira recovered is a naira we do not have to borrow.
advisorTake.security: Investigators need protection. Add it to the plan.
advisorTake.health: Procurement leakage is why our clinics lack basics. Do it.
advisorTake.politics: You will make enemies in your own party. Plan your votes.

name: Civil service pay rise
description: Raise public sector pay to keep staff working and unions calm.

sideEffects.note: Higher wages add to price pressure.

advisorTake.finance: Recurring cost with no end date. Be sure you can sustain it.
advisorTake.security: Underpaid officers cut corners. Better pay helps discipline.
advisorTake.health: Nurses and doctors need it most. Do not forget them.
advisorTake.politics: Strike risk down, loyalty up. An easy trade.
